ثُدَيَّةٌ : see ثَدْىٌ. ―
-b2- Also A repository, or receptacle, (AA, K,) of the size of the fist, (AA,) in which the horseman carries the [sinews called] عَقَب [of which the bow-string is made, and which are bound round a bow, and round an arrow, to repair a fracture in it, (see عَقَبٌ and عَقَبَ,)] and the feathers [which he may require to attach to any of his arrows]. (AA, K.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
